source: human-verified pending: drafted by Claude from the code, to be reviewed by the owner

flaws.title: Orders route takes the user id from a client header
flaws.why: withUser copies the caller's own X-User-Id header into X-Authenticated-User without checking any session, so any client can act as any user on /orders.

flaws.title: Client headers, including X-Authenticated-User, pass through unchanged
flaws.why: request.Header = r.Header forwards every client header, so on the /auth/ and /catalog/ routes (no withUser) a client can send its own X-Authenticated-User and hop-by-hop headers straight to the backend.

flaws.title: Rate limit map is written from many goroutines with no lock
flaws.why: calls is a plain map updated by every request handler concurrently, so under load Go aborts the whole gateway with a concurrent map write.

flaws.title: Rate limit counts never reset and grow without bound
flaws.why: calls[r.RemoteAddr] only ever increments, so a client is blocked for good after 100 requests and the map keeps every address ever seen.

flaws.title: Rate limit keyed on RemoteAddr including the port
flaws.why: r.RemoteAddr is ip:port, so a client opening new connections gets a fresh counter each time, while clients behind one proxy or load balancer share a single counter.

flaws.title: Proxy drops the query string
flaws.why: The upstream URL is upstream+r.URL.Path with no RawQuery, so /catalog/search?q=... reaches catalog with no query and search never works.

flaws.title: Upstream status and headers are lost
flaws.why: The proxy only io.Copy's the body, so every upstream 401, 404 or 500 reaches the client as 200 and Content-Type and other headers are dropped.

flaws.title: Upstream calls have no timeout
flaws.why: http.DefaultClient has no timeout and the client's context is not passed, so one slow backend ties up gateway connections without limit.

flaws.title: Request build error ignored
flaws.why: The error from http.NewRequest is discarded, so a request that fails to build leaves request nil and the next line panics.

flaws.title: Only the exact /orders path is routed
flaws.why: HandleFunc("/orders", ...) has no trailing slash, so /orders/{id} and any other order path get a 404 from the gateway.

flaws.title: Server has no timeouts and ignores its start error
flaws.why: http.ListenAndServe has no read or write timeouts, so slow clients can hold connections, and its returned error is dropped.
